STRESS
Acute psychological stress is associated with immune stimulation and increased
cellular host defenses.  However, chronic stress decrease humoral and cell-
mediated immunity.  Chronic stress has been correlated with increased risk of
respiratory tract infection.

Critically ill patients are usually profoundly stressed.  The risk of infection
is subtle and the defects are non-specific.
